publicApi.note: LinkedIn's official Job Posting / Talent APIs are for approved ATS and Talent Solutions partners posting jobs; there is no public job search API. Needs a partner app, so not usable (design 5.1).

auth.howToCopy: No token: only the logged-out jobs-guest pages are read, and no cookie is ever sent (not li_at, not JSESSIONID), even if the secrets file has one.

clauses: Develop, support or use software, devices, scripts, robots or any other means or processes (such as crawlers, browser plugins and add-ons or any other technology) to scrape or copy the Services, including profiles and other data from the Services;
Use bots or other unauthorized automated methods to access the Services
Override any security feature or bypass or circumvent any access controls or use limits of the Services

accountRisk: High. The User Agreement (section 8.2) forbids scraping and bots, and robots.txt (2026-10-20) disallows /jobs-guest/ and ends 'User-agent: * Disallow: /'. The reader uses the logged-out jobs-guest pages only and never sends Ba's cookies, so his account is not involved; the risk is to this Mac's IP address, which LinkedIn rate-limits: a second search page three seconds after the first answered 429 with a JavaScript cookie challenge. LinkedIn is widely reported to restrict accounts it sees automating with a member's session, which is why no session is used.
notes: Verified 2026-10-20 with guest requests only (no cookies).

Search: GET https://www.linkedin.com/jobs-guest/jobs/api/seeMoreJobPostings/search?keywords=&location=&f_TPR=&start= answers an HTML fragment of 10 <li> cards: div.base-card[data-entity-urn='urn:li:jobPosting:<id>'], h3.base-search-card__title, h4.base-search-card__subtitle a.hidden-nested-link, span.job-search-card__location, time.job-search-card__listdate[datetime], span.job-search-card__salary-info. start=10 three seconds later answered 429 with a cookie challenge.

Detail: GET https://www.linkedin.com/jobs-guest/jobs/api/jobPosting/<jobId> answers 200 with the full JD and no authwall: h2.top-card-layout__title, a.topcard__org-name-link, span.topcard__flavor--bullet, div.show-more-less-html__markup (full JD), ul.description__job-criteria-list li (h3.description__job-criteria-subheader + span.description__job-criteria-text), .compensation__salary, code#decoratedJobPostingId. Recruiter, face-pile and sign-in blocks are ignored.

Limits enforced in code: 1 search page per scan (start=0 only), at most 10 job pages, at least 3000 ms between requests to www.linkedin.com. A 429, a 999 or a challenge page stops the scan at once, with no retry: the run reads LinkedIn in the browser and Ba sees 'LinkedIn blocked the direct read'.
Never: the voyager API, li_at or JSESSIONID, the search-history POST, apply, save or any profile endpoint. Job URL: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/<id>/.
